provenance: Four original AI-generated illustrative manufacturing scenes created for this website. No third-party reference images supplied or copied. These are generic factory representations, not photographs or footage of PARK's actual facility, supplied products, approved tooling, or certified processes.
accuracyScope: Illustrates already-moulded EPP parts at demoulding, cooling or inspection. HVAC tooling is idle and open after the cycle; other scenes emphasize closed guarded machinery. No scenes depict open-tool steam fusion, active bead pouring, molten EPP, or measured production parameters. Machinery and product geometry remain illustrative.

assets.name: factory-hvac
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original website illustration of a generic EPP factory manufacturing process.
Primary request: a believable working factory after the demoulding step of expanded polypropylene (EPP) foam production. An idle, cooled steam-chest moulding press stands open, showing its empty aluminium mould tooling. A freshly demoulded charcoal EPP air duct and substantial insulation housing rest securely on an adjacent supported cooling fixture. The scene must read as a manufacturing process station, not an isolated showroom product shot.
Process accuracy: the tool is open only after the steam/fusion and cooling cycle has ended; absolutely no visible steam, active bead filling, pouring, molten material or glowing machinery. The finished foam parts are solid and matte, with fine densely fused irregular beads and plausible moulded passages. Guarded machine structure, physical rails and sensible safe access; nobody reaching into the machine.
Scene/backdrop: practical organised production hall with authentic utilitarian moulding equipment, restrained hoses and insulated services, industrial floor and depth into a real-looking factory. No futuristic robots. No showroom or studio backdrop.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 photograph, three-quarter view showing the open empty press and the cooling fixture together; manufacturing station occupies the foreground, complete foam parts supported in frame, convincing work scale.
Lighting/mood: realistic diffuse natural industrial light with subtle overhead factory illumination; candid premium industrial photography, real metal wear and matte foam texture, no glossy CGI styling.
Constraints: original generic illustrative factory; no visible people, text, fabricated readable machine labels, brand names, logos, PARK branding, certification symbols or watermarks. No liquid or melted EPP.
assets.inspection: Idle open aluminium mould tooling; solid charcoal EPP duct and housing supported on adjacent metal cooling fixture; guarded industrial equipment and factory depth. No visible steam, bead pouring, melted foam, brands or legible machine labels. Generic manufacturing illustration, not an engineering schematic.

assets.name: factory-logistics
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original website illustration of a generic EPP logistics packaging manufacturing process.
Primary request: practical factory outfeed, cooling and inspection station beside a steam-chest moulding production line. Several freshly moulded charcoal expanded polypropylene (EPP) reusable transport trays with fitted component cavities move along a short supported roller outfeed. Thick-walled insulated EPP boxes and their separate matching lids are arranged at a nearby cooling rack and inspection bench. The logistics product forms must be immediately recognizable.
Process accuracy: enclosed guarded moulding presses stand CLOSED behind the outfeed. Show solid already-formed foam parts cooling and awaiting dimensional inspection; no visible steam jets, no open press during a cycle, no bead pouring, no molten material. Trays and containers have realistic fine fused irregular bead surfaces, moulded grip recesses and substantial foam walls, without fancy graphics.
Scene/backdrop: real-looking organised production factory, plain blue-and-grey guarded machine frames, practical metal cooling racks, a simple measuring fixture, utilitarian floors and receding production depth. No warehouse showroom and no isolated product packshot.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 photograph at working height, manufacturing flow prominent in foreground with open trays and boxes supported on factory equipment; whole main product forms visible, deeper moulding line establishes process context.
Lighting/mood: natural industrial sidelight with restrained overhead lighting, premium documentary factory photography, believable metal wear, matte foam texture and soft physical shadows.
Constraints: original generic illustrative factory, not a named actual facility. No visible people, readable text, fabricated machine labels, display readouts, brands, logos, PARK branding, watermarks or certification symbols. No liquid or melted EPP.
assets.inspection: Supported charcoal fitted trays on roller outfeed with insulated box bodies and lids on cooling racks; enclosed machinery and factory depth visible. Fine foam texture and no liquid material, readable branding or active open-tool filling.

assets.name: factory-childhood
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original website illustration of generic EPP sports and early-childhood manufacturing.
Primary request: an authentic finishing and quality-inspection workstation inside a practical moulded-foam manufacturing factory. Muted sage and soft blue expanded polypropylene (EPP) play arches and play blocks sit on a sturdy clean inspection bench and supported cooling rack. A charcoal moulded foam helmet liner rests nearby on a simple head-shaped inspection fixture, clearly a bare foam liner rather than a finished branded helmet. A dimensional gauge and a restrained small hand-inspection tool are part of the workstation.
Materials/textures: recognizable densely fused small irregular EPP foam beads across coloured play components and dark liner; dry matte moulded texture, realistic solid foam wall thickness and rounded moulded edges. Avoid upholstered fabric, sparse sponge holes and glossy smooth plastic.
Process context: closed guarded moulding machinery and practical production equipment are visibly present behind the bench. Finished solid parts have already been demoulded and cooled for inspection. No steam jets, no active open mould cycle, no beads being poured and no molten foam. Show an organised manufacturing process, not a playroom, showroom or isolated studio product photo.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, foreground inspection workstation with whole main parts inside frame, manufacturing depth behind, camera at realistic standing work height; natural balanced arrangement without giant display props.
Lighting/mood: realistic calm natural factory-window light with soft overhead industrial illumination, tactile documentary industrial photography.
Constraints: original generic illustrative factory only; no visible people, readable text, fabricated machine labels, logos, brands, PARK branding, certification marks, watermarks or liquid/melted EPP.
assets.inspection: Muted sage and blue play forms on factory inspection bench and rack; bare charcoal foam helmet liner on a head-shaped gauge fixture; dimensional inspection tools and guarded machinery behind. No people or legible brand/machine text.

assets.name: factory-automotive
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original website illustration of generic automotive EPP manufacturing and inspection.
Primary request: an authentic automotive moulded-foam factory inspection station beside moulding machinery. Charcoal-black expanded polypropylene (EPP) seat-support shapes, a substantial ribbed floor-support form and a separate shaped energy absorber are held securely on simple metal inspection fixtures and an outfeed support table. The fitted shapes have convincing vehicle-component geometry. Closed guarded moulding equipment and a rack of similar finished parts establish production depth behind.
Materials/textures: realistic densely fused fine irregular EPP beads across matte solid foam surfaces, plausible moulded ribs, recesses, mounting clearances and substantial structural foam sections. Fixtures support the components physically; nothing floats or clips through another part.
Process accuracy: finished solid foam components have already been demoulded and cooled and are at dimensional inspection. Presses behind are enclosed and closed, with physical guarding and sensible factory access. No molten foam, visible steam jets, open press during a cycle, poured beads or robots presented as a standard process.
Scene/backdrop: clean but practical industrial manufacturing hall, blue-and-grey equipment, pale factory windows, functional metal jigs and production racks. This is a factory process scene, not a showroom product display or a vehicle lifestyle photograph.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 photograph, complete supported main components inside frame, clear working inspection station in foreground, guarded machinery and receding factory space behind, realistic work-height three-quarter viewpoint.
Lighting/mood: natural industrial light, soft overhead factory illumination, premium documentary photography with tactile foam detail, believable metal surfaces and physical shadows, no glossy CGI look.
Constraints: original generic illustrative factory, not an actual named facility. No visible people, readable text, fabricated machine labels, displays with invented readings, brands, logos, PARK branding, certification symbols, watermarks, liquid or melted EPP.
assets.inspection: Seat-support forms, floor-support form and energy absorber on metal inspection fixtures next to enclosed machinery and finished-part racks. Solid matte foam and realistic factory context. No people or readable logos; far-left duplicate seat form is naturally cropped at the scene edge.
